hash_object_with_Hasher: use Hasher.hash to compute a stable fingerprint for any Python object like strings, classes, or functions
incremental_hash_with_Hasher: use Hasher.update and Hasher.hexdigest to incrementally hash multiple objects into a single fingerprint
test_fingerprint_transform_decorator: test the fingerprint_transform decorator on a Dataset subclass method to verify it generates unique fingerprints
test_Hasher_with_torch_tensors: test Hasher.hash with torch tensors and generators to verify stable hashing across different values
manage_temp_cache_directory: use _TempCacheDir or get_temporary_cache_files_directory to manage temporary cache files respecting the TMPDIR environment variable
